raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

SGLang picks up an sgl-amd-mono change only after someone bumps the pin by hand. #46662 needs sgl-amd-mono#60, which neither `main` (`05e0bb02`) nor the open bump #45045 (`e952b221`) contains. This adds a bot that opens the bump daily.

## Modifications

- `.github/workflows/bot-bump-sgl-amd-mono-version.yml`: runs daily at 08:00 UTC, or by hand with an optional `ref`. It has the same steps as `bot-bump-kernel-version-to-sglang.yml`.
- `scripts/release/bump_sgl_amd_mono_version.py`: rewrites the pin in `python/pyproject_other.toml` and reports `needs_bump`.
- `scripts/release/commit_and_pr_sgl_amd_mono.sh`: opens a PR from `bot/bump-sgl-amd-mono-<sha8>` that lists the sgl-amd-mono commits, and closes the bump PR it supersedes.
- `.github/scripts/pr-title.test.cjs` and `scripts/release/README.md`: the title check and the docs.

How the bot behaves:

- A commit that already has a PR, open or closed, is skipped, so closing a bump PR without merging rejects that commit.
- The PAT closes a superseded PR, which triggers `cancel-pr-workflows-on-close.yml` to cancel its CI.
- Pushes use `GITHUB_TOKEN`, because `GH_PAT_FOR_PULL_REQUEST` cannot push (#25926). `gh` uses the PAT, so bump PRs get CI runs.
- It adds no `run-ci` label (#13486). Comment `/tag-and-rerun-ci` on a bump PR to run its CI.
- CI on a bump PR shows that the pin installs. It does not run the monokernel: no GPU test enables it, and plugin load errors are only logged.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: CI tooling only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: CI tooling only.

## Tests

- Bump script on the real file: it bumps, does nothing on a rerun, pins an explicit SHA, and rejects a missing branch or a short SHA.
- PR script with `git` and `gh` stubbed: it creates the PR, skips a commit that already has one, and supersedes an open bump PR.
- `node --test .github/scripts/pr-title.test.cjs` (99 passed), actionlint, shellcheck and pre-commit.
- Not executed: the workflow on GitHub Actions. Run it by hand once after merge, and close #45045 by hand.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+name: Bot Bump sgl-amd-mono Version
+#
+# Pins sgl-amd-mono (python/pyproject_other.toml) at the head of its main daily and opens a PR.
+on:
+  schedule:
+    - cron: '0 8 * * *'  # daily 08:00 UTC
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      ref:
+        description: 'sgl-amd-mono branch or full commit SHA to pin (default: main)'
+        required: false
+        type: string
+        default: main
+
+permissions:
+  contents: write
+  pull-requests: write
+
+jobs:
+  bump-sgl-amd-mono-version:
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          # Branch off main even when a manual run is dispatched from another branch.
+          ref: main
+          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
+
+      - name: Set up Python
+        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
+        with:
+          python-version: '3.12'
+
+      - name: Run sgl-amd-mono version bump script
+        id: bump
+        env:
+          REF: ${{ github.event.inputs.ref || 'main' }}
+        run: |
+          python scripts/release/bump_sgl_amd_mono_version.py "$REF"
+
+      - name: Commit and create PR
+        if: steps.bump.outputs.needs_bump == 'true'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_FOR_PULL_REQUEST }}
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/release/commit_and_pr_sgl_amd_mono.sh "${{ steps.bump.outputs.old_commit }}" "${{ steps.bump.outputs.new_commit }}"

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Pin sgl-amd-mono in python/pyproject_other.toml and report needs_bump to GitHub Actions."""
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+SGL_AMD_MONO_REPO = "https://github.com/sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono.git"
+PIN_PATTERN = re.compile(r"(sgl-amd-mono\.git@)([0-9a-f]{40})")
+
+
+def resolve_commit(ref: str) -> str:
+    """Resolve a branch of sgl-amd-mono to its head commit; a full SHA passes through."""
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", ref):
+        return ref
+
+    refs = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "ls-remote", SGL_AMD_MONO_REPO, f"refs/heads/{ref}"],
+        check=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+    ).stdout.split()
+    if not refs:
+        sys.exit(f"Error: {ref} is not a full commit SHA or an sgl-amd-mono branch")
+
+    return refs[0]
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "ref", nargs="?", default="main", help="sgl-amd-mono branch or full commit SHA"
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    new_commit = resolve_commit(args.ref)
+
+    pyproject_path = Path("python/pyproject_other.toml")
+    content = pyproject_path.read_text()
+    pins = PIN_PATTERN.findall(content)
+    if len(pins) != 1:
+        sys.exit(f"Error: expected one sgl-amd-mono pin, found {len(pins)}")
+    old_commit = pins[0][1]
+
+    needs_bump = old_commit != new_commit
+    if needs_bump:
+        pyproject_path.write_text(PIN_PATTERN.sub(rf"\g<1>{new_commit}", content))
+        print(f"✓ Bumped sgl-amd-mono in {pyproject_path}: {old_commit} → {new_commit}")
+    else:
+        print(f"✓ {pyproject_path} already pins sgl-amd-mono at {new_commit}")
+
+    github_output = os.getenv("GITHUB_OUTPUT")
+    if github_output:
+        with open(github_output, "a") as f:
+            f.write(
+                f"needs_bump={str(needs_bump).lower()}\n"
+                f"old_commit={old_commit}\nnew_commit={new_commit}\n"
+            )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Script to commit an sgl-amd-mono pin bump to SGLang and create a pull request
+# Usage: commit_and_pr_sgl_amd_mono.sh <old_commit> <new_commit>
+
+OLD_COMMIT="${1:-}"
+NEW_COMMIT="${2:-}"
+
+if [ -z "$OLD_COMMIT" ] || [ -z "$NEW_COMMIT" ]; then
+    echo "Usage: $0 <old_commit> <new_commit>"
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+MONO_REPO="sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono"
+OLD_SHORT_SHA="${OLD_COMMIT:0:8}"
+NEW_SHORT_SHA="${NEW_COMMIT:0:8}"
+# One branch per target commit, so a closed bump PR is not reopened for it.
+BRANCH_PREFIX="bot/bump-sgl-amd-mono-"
+BRANCH_NAME="${BRANCH_PREFIX}${NEW_SHORT_SHA}"
+
+if [ -n "$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH_NAME" --state all --json number --jq '.[].number')" ]; then
+    echo "A PR from ${BRANCH_NAME} already exists; nothing to do."
+    exit 0
+fi
+
+OPEN_BUMP_PRS=$(gh pr list --author "@me" --state open --limit 100 --json number,headRefName \
+    --jq ".[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"${BRANCH_PREFIX}\")) | \"\(.number) \(.headRefName)\"")
+
+# Commit titles cite their PRs as (#N), which would link to SGLang PRs here.
+CHANGES=$(gh api "repos/${MONO_REPO}/compare/${OLD_COMMIT}...${NEW_COMMIT}" \
+    --jq '.commits[] | "- [`\(.sha[0:8])`](\(.html_url)) \(.commit.message | split("\n")[0])"' \
+    | sed -E "s|\(#([0-9]+)\)|(${MONO_REPO}#\1)|g")
+
+git config user.name "sglang-bot"
+git config user.email "sglang-bot@users.noreply.github.com"
+git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
+git commit -am "chore: pin sgl-amd-mono at ${NEW_SHORT_SHA}"
+# --force: an earlier run may have pushed this branch without opening its PR.
+git push --force origin "$BRANCH_NAME"
+
+PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
+  --title "[Chore] [AMD] monokernels: Pin sgl-amd-mono at ${NEW_SHORT_SHA}" \
+  --body "Pins \`sgl-amd-mono\` (the \`monokernels_hip\` extra) at \`${NEW_SHORT_SHA}\`, up from \`${OLD_SHORT_SHA}\` ([full diff](https://github.com/${MONO_REPO}/compare/${OLD_COMMIT}...${NEW_COMMIT})).
+
+${CHANGES}
+
+🤖 Generated with GitHub Actions" \
+  --base main \
+  --head "$BRANCH_NAME")
+echo "Created ${PR_URL}"
+
+while read -r OLD_PR OLD_BRANCH; do
+    [ -n "$OLD_PR" ] || continue
+    # Closed with the PAT, so cancel-pr-workflows-on-close.yml runs and cancels its CI.
+    gh pr close "$OLD_PR" --comment "Superseded by ${PR_URL}."
+    git push origin --delete "$OLD_BRANCH"
+done <<< "$OPEN_BUMP_PRS"
